sentences.en: Back in the late 1980s, when Luis Gallo was a little kid growing up in Colombia,
sentences.zh: 在上世纪80年代末，当路易斯·加洛还是哥伦比亚的一个小男孩时，

sentences.en: he and his brother didn't have babysitters.
His parents would send them to school in an SUV that was accompanied by another identical SUV,
sentences.zh: 他的父母会用一辆SUV送他们去学校，后面还会跟着一辆一模一样的SUV，
那是一辆用来迷惑视线的诱饵车。

sentences.en: Because that meant if one of the vehicles was attacked, there would be a chance we would not be in it.
sentences.zh: 因为这意味着如果其中一辆车遭到袭击，我们坐那辆车的概率就会降低。

sentences.en: Our life was strange in many ways back then.
sentences.zh: 当时我们的生活在很多方面都很奇怪。

sentences.en: My brother and I had our own bedrooms, but every night, our whole family would sleep in the same room.
sentences.zh: 我和哥哥有各自的卧室，但每天晚上，我们全家人都会睡在同一个房间里。

sentences.en: It had a door to the back patio and a ladder ready to use in case we needed to flee.
sentences.zh: 那里有一扇通往后院的门，还准备好了一把梯子，以防我们需要逃跑。

sentences.en: My parents made it seem like we were just having a slumber party.
sentences.zh: 我的父母把它伪装得好像我们只是在开睡衣派对。

sentences.en: But the real reason that Luis's family took these precautions
sentences.zh: 但路易斯一家采取这些预防措施的真正原因

sentences.en: is that Luis's dad was a captain in the anti-narcotics unit for Colombia's National Police.
sentences.zh: 是路易斯的父亲担任哥伦比亚国家警察缉毒局的队长。

sentences.en: And Pablo Escobar, the notorious drug lord, had declared war on the police.
sentences.zh: 而大毒枭巴勃罗·埃斯科瓦尔已经向警方宣战。

sentences.en: On the whole Colombian state, really.
sentences.zh: 确切地说，是向整个哥伦比亚国家宣战。

sentences.en: It's become a typical day in Colombia.
sentences.zh: 这成了哥伦比亚稀松平常的一天。

sentences.en: Three more judges have quit their jobs after being threatened by the murderous drug cartels.
sentences.zh: 在受到谋杀成性的贩毒集团威胁后，又有三名法官辞职。

sentences.en: The government has imposed a curfew in nine cities in the heart of cocaine country,
sentences.zh: 政府在可卡因腹地的九个城市实施了宵禁，
其中包括贩毒集团的大本营麦德林。

sentences.en: By the late 80s and early 90s, Escobar was supplying 80% of the world's cocaine.
sentences.zh: 到了80年代末和90年代初，埃斯科瓦尔供应了全球80%的可卡因。

sentences.en: And the violence surrounding the drug trade had gotten really bad.
sentences.zh: 毒品交易所引发的暴力活动变得异常严重。

sentences.en: The epicenter of the violence was Medellin.
sentences.zh: 暴力事件的震中就是麦德林。

sentences.en: Escobar's cartel was based there, and they controlled much of the city.
sentences.zh: 埃斯科瓦尔的贩毒集团总部就在那里，他们控制了这座城市的大部分地区。

sentences.en: Thirteen bombs have gone off in Medellin since the weekend,
sentences.zh: 自周末以来，麦德林已经发生了十三起爆炸事件，

sentences.en: all aimed at government-owned banks or state liquor stores.
sentences.zh: 目标全部是国有银行或国家烈酒商店。

sentences.en: Medellin became the most dangerous city in the world.
sentences.zh: 麦德林成了世界上最危险的城市。

sentences.en: In 1991 alone, around 6,000 people were killed.
sentences.zh: 仅在1991年，就有大约6000人丧生。

sentences.en: The murder rate was almost 400 people per 100,000 residents,
sentences.zh: 谋杀率几乎达到每10万名居民中有400人，

sentences.en: which, to put things in perspective,

sentences.en: that's three or four times more than the most violent cities in the world today.
sentences.zh: 这比当今世界上最暴力的城市还要高出三到四倍。

sentences.en: But today, Medellin is very different.
sentences.zh: 但如今的麦德林已经大不相同了。

sentences.en: In just 30 years, it's changed from being the bloody cocaine capital of the world
sentences.zh: 仅仅30年时间，它就从血腥的世界可卡因之都，

sentences.en: into a place that's often described as a model city.
sentences.zh: 变成了一个常被誉为模范城市的地方。

sentences.en: It's now safer than many cities in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 它现在的治安甚至比许多美国城市还要好。

sentences.en: And amazingly, one of the things that helped to pull the city out of the violence
sentences.zh: 令人惊叹的是，帮助这座城市摆脱暴力阴影的举措之一，

sentences.en: including a major overhaul of the city's public transportation system.
